rooms.name: In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You now stand inside the entrance to the mine.  The interior is
extremely dark and there is a rather pungent odor within the confines of
these mines.  You notice many footprints scattered about the floor of the
mine, indicating that you are not alone in here.  To the west is the exit to
the desert, and to the north and south lie passages that continue on into
the depths of the mine.

rooms.name: In The Mines
rooms.desc:
The passageway here feels as if it is sloping downward but it is
impossible to tell because of the vast darkness that seems to engulf
everything.  The passage heads north while a side passage leads off
to the east.

rooms.name: The End Of The Passageway
rooms.desc:
You appear to have reached a dead end as the passage ends at a solid
wall of rock.  The only exit leads back to the south.

rooms.name: In The Mines
rooms.desc:
This passage seems a bit more narrow than the previous one and it appears
to be closing in just a bit.  This place definitely is not for one who is
claustrophobic.  A passage leads back north.  A small passageway heads towards
the south.

rooms.name: In A Small Passageway
rooms.desc:
You are now in a much smaller passage than earlier, with there only
being a clearance of about a couple of feet above your head.  The path turns
now so that it heads north or east.

rooms.name: A Cavern In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You emerge from the small passageway into a very large cavern.  As
you gaze around the cavern you notice several large holes in the walls of
the cavern.  You manage to look up and notice thousands of bats sleeping
and you hope like hell that they don't wake up.  To the north lies a
passageway and to the west lies a small passageway.

rooms.name: Another Passage
rooms.desc:
Once again, you stand in a passageway.  There is plenty of clearance
on all sides in this passageway and there seem to be some more signs of recent
life in here.  There are several large holes scattered about in the walls of
the passage.  There are also some mining instruments lying around on the
floor.  You wonder if the owner is still around...  Exits lead to the west
and to the south.

rooms.name: A Wide Passage Through The Mines
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a wider passage that continues on to the north.  A smaller
passage heads back to the west.

rooms.name: Yet Another Passage
rooms.desc:
You now stand in yet another passage in the mines.  You are beginning
to wonder if there is an end to this tunnel system.  There appear to be no
holes or other signs of life in this passage.  There are exits leading west
and south.

rooms.name: A Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
As you emerge from the passageway, you notice you are in a small
cavern.  In the corner there are some beds of straw and in the center of
the cavern is a smoldering campfire.  Whoever was camping here was here
VERY recently.  Exits lie to the east and to the north.

rooms.name: A Large Cavern
rooms.desc:
You now enter a much larger cavern.  After looking around the cavern,
there appear to be no signs of life.  There ARE several holes in this cavern,
however.  These holes indicate someone has been mining here recently.
Exits lead in all directions.

rooms.name: A Passage Through The Mines
rooms.desc:
You now stand within another passage.  You feel the passage getting
a bit narrower as you walk down it.  Exits are to the east and the south.

rooms.name: A Very Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in another small cavern, this one being the smallest yet.
As you stand in this cavern, you feel as if you are being watched by someone.
You seem to be drawn further into the mine by some mysterious force. Lucky
for you there are no bats in this cavern.  You hope that this trend continues.
There are passages to the east, west and the north as well.

rooms.name: A Junction In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large cavern that seems to be some sort of 3 way
junction with exits leading west, east, and south.  There are many supports
helping to support the weight of the tunnels.

rooms.name: A Small Passageway
rooms.desc: The passage now turns so that it leads north or west.

rooms.name: The Entrance To The Demon's Lair
rooms.desc:
You stand in a large cavern in front of what looks like a lair of
some sort.  You feel EXTREMELY uneasy standing here.  The evil power
emanating from this lair is very strong.  It feels as if it is going to
engulf you.  There are many skeletons littering the area indicating that
you are not the only person ever to think of entering this lair.  Obviously
for these past adventurers that was probably their last thought ever.
Exits lead to the west and the lair or to the south and back into the passage.
It is too dark to see into the lair.

rooms.name: The Demon Knight's Lair
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a lair of some sort and immediately you
notice that the room is littered with hundreds of bones of all types.
Obviously you are not the first to enter this room.  The walls are red
with blood stains and in fact, some of it is still wet!

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in the center of a large cavern that strangely enough,
is very smooth.  To the north, you can see an eerie glowing light and a
figure standing before it.  The passage continues on to the north towards
the light.  Another passage leads off to the south back to a large cavern.

rooms.name: The Idol Chamber
rooms.desc:
Upon entering the room, you immediately notice that the chamber 
is lit with an eerie glow.  There are many ancient carvings on the wall 
that look like warnings of some kind.  Lining the room are several statues 
that resemble apes.  At the center of the room there is an altar that is
slightly elevated.  As you look up at the altar, a man turns around to 
face you.

rooms.name: Another Passage In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You stand in yet another passageway through the mines.  You are again
amazed at the extensive tunnelwork in this mountain and wonder who or what
built these tunnels.  You can head back to the west or continue on to the
east.

rooms.name: A 3-way Junction In The Mines
rooms.desc:
You are now in a junction with passages leading off in three
directions: north, east and west.  There are no bats or any other signs of
life in this cavern.

rooms.name: A Small Passageway
rooms.desc:
As you look around this passageway you notice footprints scattered
about in the dirt, indicating that some kind of a fight occured here.  You
look in the corner and see what appears to be the loser of this fight as
there is nothing more than a skull lying in the dirt.  Exits lead to the
east and to the west.

rooms.name: A Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in another small cavern with more footprints scattered about
the room.  You notice several broken mining instruments lying about and a few
skeletons.  The exits lead to the north and to the west.

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
As you enter this particular cavern you see a couple of straw beds
and a smoldering campfire.  You do not see anyone around in the immediate
vicinity, but you feel as though you are being watched...  The only exit is
to the south.

rooms.name: A Passageway Through The Mines
rooms.desc:
You emerge from the large cavern into a rather large passage.  The
walls are somewhat smoother here and it feels as though this tunnel is 
sloping downwards ever so slightly.  Exits lead to the west and the east.

rooms.name: The Passage Continues
rooms.desc:
You are still traveling in the same passageway.  You look around but
do not notice any signs of life.  The tunnel now turns so that it heads to
the north or the west.

rooms.name: A Medium-Sized Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in a moderately large cavern.  As you gaze up you notice
thousands of bats perched up there.  On the floor of the cavern you see
many footprints.  Littering the floor are small pieces of wood and many
rocks that were probably chipped off of the walls by miners.  You can exit
to the north, south or east.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc:
You are in a tunnel that has been closed off where the tunnel has
collapsed in on itself and completely blocked passage.  The only exit leads
back to the south.

rooms.name: In A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You stand in a tunnel that does not look like it will continue
standing for much longer.  The supports here are buckling badly.  You feel
that staying here much longer would be unadvisable.  Exits lead to the east
and west.

rooms.name: Another Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in yet another cavern except this cavern is different from
the rest.  You notice several footprints in this cavern as you have in
previous ones.  As you look to the east you notice a large door.  The exits
lead north, south, and east.

rooms.name: A Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are in a cavern that is littered with skeletons and small pieces
of wood and rock.  There appear to be no other signs of life.  You look up
but notice no bats in this cavern.  The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: A Very Small Cavern
rooms.desc:
You stand in a VERY small cavern.  You have to duck in order to keep
from hitting your head on the top of the cavern.  There are no signs of life
in this cavern.  You notice that the tunnel that leads out of this cavern to
the north has collapsed leaving no exit except the one to the south.

rooms.name: The Entrance To The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a room of sorts with some of the walls being solid
rock and other walls appearing to be manmade.  These walls consist mostly of
large blocks of rock stacked upon each other.  You wonder how it is possible
to stack these inside of a mountain.  Exits lie to the north, south and to
the west.

rooms.name: A Turn In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You notice a skeleton in the corner with an evil smile on it's face.
You wonder what happened to this poor man when he died.  The dust on the
floor is very thick indicating to you that no one has come this way in a LONG
time, and probably for good reason.  There are spider webs that litter the
walls and the passage.  You will have to walk through them in order to
continue on to the east, YUCK!  Exits lead to the east and the north.

rooms.name: The Picture Room
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a room with hundreds of pictures littering the
walls.  These pictures cover all sides of the room, including the ceiling.
The room is also covered with skeletons.  You can now see why no one has
come this way in many years.  You wonder what could have killed all of these
men.  To the east lies a small door, to the west a bend in the passage, and
to the south lies a door.

rooms.name: A Small Room
rooms.desc:
You now stand in a small room with no decorations or pictures of any
kind on the walls.  You notice that for some strange reason the room is
free of any type of life.  There are no webs and a minimal amount of dirt and
dust built up on the floor.  You wonder if some type of magical force is
causing this.  You are surprised to find that you do not need a light in
order to see in this room.  Strange, strange indeed.  The only exit lies to
the west.

rooms.name: The CryptKeeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
You stand in the CryptKeeper's lair.  As you look around you notice
many skulls lined up on a bookshelf, obviously his trophies.  There is also
a large table at the back of the room that is somewhat elevated.  A chair
stands behind the table.  There are other shelves with many weird looking
concoctions on them and very old books.  You look up and notice an odd
looking skeleton standing before you.

rooms.name: In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You stand in a tunnel in the tomb.  You notice a large spider web in
front of you and you do not relish the thought of having to walk through
that.  The exits lead south and north.

rooms.name: In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
You stand in another room in the tomb.  You are now covered in spider
web after walking into this room.  You notice footprints in this room and
wonder who could have come through here recently.  There is a hole in the
wall and there are snakes crawling out of it.  You don't think you want to
stay near them too long as they are beginning to cover the entire floor.
To the east and south lie the exits.

rooms.name: The Cockroach Room
rooms.desc:
You walk into the room and notice that the floor appears to be moving
because it is covered with cockroaches!  You are now walking on cockroaches.
You can hear the CRUNCH! CRUNCH! as you walk on them.  You should leave here
before these cockroaches are swarming on you!  Exits lead west and south.

rooms.name: A Large Room In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
This room is rather large and rather empty.  There are no signs of
life except for some footprints leading through a door.  You wonder what
passed through there recently and if it is still alive.  To the east lies a
large steel door and to the north lies the cockroach room.

rooms.name: Through The Steel Door
rooms.desc:
You have now passed through the steel door and stand in a much
smaller room than you were just in.  The walls here are littered with
pictures.  To the north lies a room, to the south lies another room and to
the west lies a steel door.

rooms.name: A Small Room
rooms.desc:
There are no pictures on the walls here, instead there are a number
of shelves lining the walls.  On these shelves there are various forms of
pottery and utensils made from clay.  These must have belonged to whoever is
buried in this tomb.  The only exit lies to the south.

rooms.name: Another Small Room In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
This room is lined with pictures much like the ones in the previous
room.  You see pictures depicting hunting, ruling, eating, and many other
actions.  These must represent some of the accomplishments of whoever is
buried here in this tomb.  The exits lead to the north and to the east.

rooms.name: The Guardian Room
rooms.desc:
You are now in a large room with pictures lining the walls.  Standing
before you is a large statue that appears to be guarding the small room
directly behind it.  You wonder if it is just a decoration or if it is
actually guarding the room.  The only way you could find out would be to try
to walk past it.  The exits are to the west and the east.

rooms.name: King Solomon's Tomb
rooms.desc:
You are now in a room lined with gold.  A wise and decrepit 
looking old man stands before you adorned all in gold.  He does not 
appear to be living and yet he is standing in front of you. There are 
no spider webs, animals or insects of any kind in this room.  Amazingly 
there is also no dust or dirt in this room, the walls and floor are 
perfectly clean.  There must be some type of magical force that is
causing this, you wonder what it could be.  The only exit is west.
